messages:
jana: Heads up — finance wants a Q2 GPU-hour estimate for embedding + rerank. Need separate sizing for realtime vs batch and impact of the May promo spike. Anyone have recent sim runs?
omar: We ran a Monte Carlo sim in Jan but it assumed flat traffic. Last time we modeled the promo spike it increased peak GPU-hours by ~28% and moved the 95th percentile up 2x.
kevin: Pushed the old sim here: https://redwood.internal/sims/embedding-rerank-jan. Quick summary:
```
model: embed-large, rerank: cross-encoder
qps_peak: 180 (region), avg_seq_len: 256
batch_size(batch): 1024, realtime_batch: 8
estimated_gpu_hours/day: 480 (flat)
```
sara: My recommendation: keep realtime in small low-latency pools per region (8–16 GPUs), and run batch/backfill in a separate burst pool. Warm KV/prefix cache for rerank saved ~12–18% GPU-hours in last trial.
maria: EU region note — marketing campaign in May is EU-first. Expect EU demand +40% for 10 days. If we don't provision regionally we'll pay cross-region egress and experience higher latencies.
sasha: Also consider 4-bit quant for rerank candidates. In benching it dropped GPU-hours ~30% but added ~10–15ms p95 latency. Might be fine for batch, questionable for realtime.
kevin: Proposed quick plan:
- realtime pool: 3 regions x 12 GPUs = 36 A100 (serve SLO ~120ms)
- batch reserve: 200 GPU-hours/day baseline, with autoscale to 800 GPU-hours for backfills (burst window)
- enable warm cache prefill each night for top-100k prefixes
Cost estimate rough: $2.7/GPU-hour -> baseline monthly cost ~ (36*24*30*$2.7) + batch hours => ~$87k + batch costs.
infra-bot: deploy: capacity-sim-job/2026-03-10 started by kevin
jana: Action items: @kevin run new sim with day-of-week traffic + May promo; @sara run 7-day warm-cache prefill trial and report cache hit delta; @maria confirm marketing calendar and expected EU qps windows. I'll consolidate numbers for finance by EOD Friday :thumbsup:
omar: FYI: we should also test network egress on small replicas — cross-region fallback increases p95 by ~80ms in our last experiment.
kevin: I'll have the sim repo updated and a small dashboard for the 95/99 pcts. Will post link here when done.
sara: If the warm-cache trial shows >15% savings we can shift some batch work into off-peak windows to reduce burst costs.
jana: perfect — thanks all :rocket:
